2026-11-07.headline: NDES guidance adds SID certificate request settings and validation safeguards
2026-11-07.overview: A new AD CS article explains how to configure NDES to accept SID information in certificate requests through registry settings for SAN URI and NTDS CA security extension formats.
2026-11-07.adminImpact: Enable the settings only when a trusted component validates the SID. Incorrect validation could enable impersonation or elevation of privilege; apply the changes by resetting IIS or restarting NDES.

keyChanges.title: New AD CS guidance covers SID-enabled NDES requests
keyChanges.detail: The article documents registry configuration for accepting SID information in certificate requests, including SAN URI and NTDS CA security extension formats. It advises that a trusted component validate the SID before enabling these settings and specifies resetting IIS or restarting NDES to apply changes.

2026-11-11.headline: SID-bearing certificate requests: NDES guidance explains SAN, extension, and custom policy-module exception
2026-11-11.overview: The 11 November batch was largely documentation maintenance, with the most substantive update in AD CS. NDES guidance now covers certificate requests carrying SID information in the SAN or a separate SID extension, including the custom policy module exception. Other meaningful edits refresh VM conversion links for VDDK 8.0.3 and Changed Block Tracking troubleshooting, while Active Directory and AD FS received narrower reference and wording updates.
2026-11-11.adminImpact: Review the NDES guidance when designing or troubleshooting certificate enrollment involving SID data. For VM conversion, use the updated Broadcom Support link to obtain VDDK 8.0.3; the required version and extraction path are unchanged. The OWASP and CBT changes direct administrators to updated external resources, and no action is indicated for the AD FS revision.

keyChanges.title: NDES guidance details SID data in SANs and separate certificate extensions
keyChanges.detail: The AD CS article now describes NDES behavior for requests containing SID information in the SAN or in a separate SID extension, including the exception for custom policy modules. Administrators working on affected enrollment scenarios should consult this guidance during design or troubleshooting.

keyChanges.title: VM conversion guidance links directly to Broadcom for VDDK 8.0.3
keyChanges.detail: The migration procedure now points to Broadcom Support for downloading VMware VDDK 8.0.3. The required version and extraction path remain unchanged, so the practical action is to use the updated download link.

keyChanges.title: Changed Block Tracking troubleshooting now uses a new Broadcom guide URL
keyChanges.detail: The VM conversion troubleshooting article now links to a new Broadcom VDDK Programming Guide URL for Changed Block Tracking troubleshooting. Administrators following the article will be directed to that updated resource.

keyChanges.title: Active Directory security guidance now links to OWASP’s 2025 Top 10
keyChanges.detail: The Avenues To Compromise article replaces its former OWASP index link with the OWASP 2025 Top 10 page, directing readers to current vulnerability and countermeasure information. No configuration change is required.

keyChanges.title: AD FS smart-lockout guidance revises proxy request wording and metadata
keyChanges.detail: The AD FS extranet smart lockout article received updated DevRel metadata links and a minor revision describing ESL requests through Web Application Proxy or an MS-ADFSPIP-compatible third-party proxy. No administrator action is indicated.

2026-11-12.headline: AD FS FAQ ties unknown domain identifiers to controller discovery and CLDAP safeguards
2026-11-12.overview: An updated AD FS troubleshooting FAQ explains that unrecognized domain identifiers in username and password requests can trigger domain controller discovery, including DNS SRV queries and CLDAP pings. It recommends Extranet Smart Lockout on Windows Server 2019 and later, along with restricting outbound CLDAP traffic.
2026-11-12.adminImpact: AD FS administrators should review these security recommendations and verify authentication, including cross-forest authentication, after applying firewall restrictions.

keyChanges.title: AD FS guidance details domain-controller discovery triggered by unknown identifiers
keyChanges.detail: The FAQ says unrecognized domain identifiers in username and password requests can initiate domain controller discovery through DNS SRV queries and CLDAP pings. It recommends Extranet Smart Lockout for Windows Server 2019 and later and restricting outbound CLDAP traffic.

2026-11-02.headline: New NDES guidance covers SID certificate requests through two registry formats
2026-11-02.overview: The week brought one new AD CS procedure: configuring Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES) to accept SID information in certificate requests through SAN URI and NTDS CA security extension formats.
2026-11-02.adminImpact: Enable the settings only when a trusted component validates the SID, because incorrect validation could enable impersonation or elevation of privilege. Apply the configuration by resetting IIS or restarting NDES.

keyChanges.title: NDES SID request configuration
keyChanges.detail: The new AD CS article explains how to use registry settings for the SAN URI and NTDS CA security extension formats when configuring NDES to accept SID information in certificate requests. It also specifies the validation condition and requires an IIS reset or NDES restart after applying the changes.

2026-11-09.headline: AD FS guidance details CLDAP discovery and recommends Smart Lockout and egress restrictions
2026-11-09.overview: The week's most consequential update is an AD FS FAQ explanation that unrecognized domain identifiers in username and password requests can trigger domain-controller discovery through DNS SRV queries and CLDAP pings. It recommends Extranet Smart Lockout for Windows Server 2019 and later and restricting outbound CLDAP, with authentication—including cross-forest flows—tested after firewall changes. Other useful updates clarify NDES handling of SID-bearing certificate requests and refresh links used by VM migration and Active Directory security guidance.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: AD FS administrators should review the Smart Lockout and outbound-CLDAP recommendations against their deployments and validate authentication after any firewall changes. AD CS and migration administrators should use the updated enrollment guidance and VDDK download link; the Active Directory OWASP link update requires no configuration change.

keyChanges.title: AD FS FAQ explains domain discovery caused by unrecognized identifiers

It recommends Extranet Smart Lockout on Windows Server 2019 and later and restricting outbound CLDAP; authentication, including cross-forest authentication, should be checked after applying firewall restrictions.

keyChanges.title: NDES guidance covers SID data in certificate requests
keyChanges.detail: The updated guidance explains NDES behavior when certificate requests carry SID information in the subject alternative name or in a separate SID extension, including the exception for custom policy modules. Review it when troubleshooting or designing SID-aware NDES enrollment.

keyChanges.title: VM conversion guidance points administrators to VDDK 8.0.3 downloads
keyChanges.detail: The migration procedure now links to Broadcom Support for VMware VDDK 8.0.3. The required version and extraction path remain unchanged, so administrators following the procedure should use the new download destination.

keyChanges.detail: The Avenues To Compromise article replaces its former OWASP index link with the OWASP 2025 Top 10 page, directing readers to the current vulnerability and countermeasure information without requiring configuration changes.

2026-11.headline: New NDES SID certificate procedure pairs with AD FS CLDAP defense guidance
2026-11.overview: November’s substantive Windows Server guidance centered on AD CS and AD FS: a new NDES procedure covers SID-bearing certificate requests, while an AD FS FAQ documents DNS and CLDAP domain-controller discovery and recommends Smart Lockout and outbound-CLDAP restrictions. Other updates were narrower maintenance, including an NDES behavior clarification and refreshed Broadcom and OWASP links.
2026-11.adminImpact: For NDES deployments, enable the SID-request settings only when a trusted component validates the SID, then reset IIS or restart NDES. AD FS administrators applying outbound-CLDAP restrictions should validate authentication, including cross-forest flows, and review Extranet Smart Lockout on Windows Server 2019 and later. Migration administrators should use the updated VDDK 8.0.3 link; the OWASP and troubleshooting-link updates require no configuration changes.

Apply the configuration by resetting IIS or restarting NDES.
